messages:
leah_ml: Quick bring-up note for horizon-65b: enabled speculative decode + q5-compact on a small canary. large tail wins but a measurable drop in slot-consistency on templated tasks. saving initial observations here.
brad_serving: can you paste the quick numbers you pulled?
leah_ml: tiny snapshot we exported:
```csv
variant,p50_ms,p95_ms,slot_consistency_pct,commit_stability_mean
baseline,220,610,99.6,0.92
spec+q5,160,420,96.8,0.74
spec-only,175,450,99.3,0.90
q5-only,210,590,98.9,0.85
```
nimal: interesting. suggest we add a "commit_stability" metric (fraction of tokens where top1 before commit == top1 after quant kernel) and a per-token flip-rate histogram. that should isolate quant amplification at commit.
rook_ops: two shards rolled back (OOM during a short burst). eviction traces show KV-cache churn spiking ~30s before the reported failures. might be related.
brad_serving: hypothesis: q5 skews low-prob tails; speculative commits on marginal gaps -> single-token slot flips. also check whether commit happens pre-whitespace-normalization (we've seen punctuation flips before).
leah_ml: next steps (short): 1) run 3 holdouts bucketed by prompt type: templated-fill, conversational, long-context 2) instrument commit_stability and top2_gap at commit 3) try q6-emul as intermediate quant floor 4) sweep spec.fill_ratio in [0.4,0.6,0.8] 5) add small adversarial templated set (~300 cases).
nimal: i'll own instrumentation + small adversarial set. estimate ~6h to wire and run on 16 shards.
leah_ml: ops-bot, please schedule the job "horizon65b-commit-stability-scan" staggered across shards. keep logs token-id-only (no free text).
ops-bot: Job horizon65b-commit-stability-scan created by leah_ml. shards: 16, ETA start in 2h.
